Projects

Design, build, and renovation

Renovation and enhancement, coordinated with landscape architects. Not a standalone architecture practice.

Request a quote

Texas Landscape Services states that it does not sell standalone landscape design. Design for renovations, improvements, and enhancements is done in house. Full design is coordinated with landscape architects — the client’s, or practices the company already works with.

Renovation, in their own description, is an updated look that does not throw away what is already in the ground.

They also say project planning should account for materials, soils, site conditions, and the cost of keeping the landscape alive after installation.

Included in the public offer

  • Landscape renovation and enhancement
  • In-house design for improvements
  • Coordination with landscape architects
  • Plant and material choices matched to the site

Other services

  • Commercial landscape management
  • Estate and residential grounds
  • Maintenance programs
